question: ______ was the first Indian man to win gold at Commonwealth Games 2022 held at Birmingham.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jeremy Lalrinnunga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• At the 2018 Commonwealth Games in Birmingham, **Jeremy Lalrinnunga **wrote history by **winning India's second gold medal**.
 
• The 19-year-old lifted a combined weight of 300 kg to win the **top prize in the Men's 67 kg competition **(140kg in snatch, 160kg in clean & jerk).
 
• The weightlifter broke the Commonwealth Games 2022 record with his 140 kg
